[SWS_CRYPT_40946]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::cryp::Key-
DerivationFunctionCtx::GetTargetAllowedUsage
shall return the allowed
usage flags of the derived key.
•
If the context has not yet been configured by a call to
ara::crypto::cryp::
KeyDerivationFunctionCtx::Init
and a
ara::crypto::cryp::Re-
strictedUseObject
has been provided as source
Key Material
, the al-
lowed usage flags of the source key-material shall be returned.
•
If the context has not yet been configured by a call to
ara::crypto::cryp::
KeyDerivationFunctionCtx::Init
and no
ara::crypto::cryp::Re-
strictedUseObject
has been provided as source
Key Material
,
kAl-
lowKdfMaterialAnyUsage
shall be returned.
